title: We found 71 forgotten versions of our own system.
hook: We audited ourselves and found 71 versions of our system nobody was using.
thesis: During the MVP audit we counted 71 stranded worktrees, parallel versions of PING work that nobody had converged. Instead of hiding it, it became a standing law: search the whole repo before you build, because a narrow search produces false confidence that your new thing is new. It is an honest, funny, human story that teaches convergence over invention.

verified: 71 stranded worktrees were counted and recorded as convergence debt in the 2026-09-29 MVP review (SYSTEMS.md section 1).
inferred: Stranded work is a pattern most engineering teams also live with, so the story is broadly relatable.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
